summary: The diff implements a comprehensive cricket scoreboard application with a Motoko backend and React frontend. Most requirements are addressed, but several specific acceptance criteria have gaps or are only partially implemented. The backend uses a single actor but does not use stable variables for persistence. Several backend functions specified in REQ-2 appear missing or incomplete in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Stable variables must be used so data persists across canister upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff shows 'var nextMatchId', 'var nextInningsId', and 'let matches = Map.empty<Nat, Match>()' — none of these use the 'stable' keyword. Without stable variables, data will be lost on canister upgrades.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fall of wickets data type (wicket number, score at fall, over at fall, batsman name) must be part of the backend data model as a dedicated field.
missing_requirements.reason: The Innings type in the backend does not include a dedicated fallOfWickets field. The frontend FallOfWickets component derives this data client-side from deliveries, rather than storing it in the backend model as specified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Match result must be stored as a structured record with winner, margin, and result type as separate fields.
missing_requirements.reason: The Match type only has 'result: ?Text' — a plain text field — rather than a structured result record with winner, margin, and result type as separate fields.

missing_requirements.requirement: switchInnings function must be implemented in the backend.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not show a switchInnings function in the backend. The visible backend only shows createMatch, listMatches, getMatch, startInnings, addBattingEntry, and partial content. No switchInnings is visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: concludeMatch function must auto-calculate and store the result (winner by runs, wickets, draw, or tie).
missing_requirements.reason: No concludeMatch function implementation is visible in the backend diff. The frontend hooks reference it but the backend implementation is not shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: getSampleDemoMatch must return a pre-populated match with at least one completed innings of demo data.
missing_requirements.reason: No getSampleDemoMatch function implementation is visible in the backend diff. While useQueries.ts references it, the backend implementation is absent from the shown code.

missing_requirements.requirement: Wicket delivery must record fall of wicket with score and over in the backend data.
missing_requirements.reason: There is no fallOfWickets array in the Innings type, so wicket deliveries cannot persistently record fall-of-wicket data in the backend as required.

hallucinated_features.description: NewBowlerDialog component prompting for a new bowler at the start of each over.
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec does not mention a per-over bowler selection dialog. The spec only mentions addBowler as a backend function and showing the current bowler. A modal dialog triggered per over was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: StartInningsDialog prompting for two opening batsmen and an opening bowler together before each innings.
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec mentions addBatsman and addBowler backend functions and prompting for the next batsman after a wicket, but does not specify a combined opener-and-bowler dialog at innings start as a UI requirement.
